cards.headline: Barça come from two goals down to beat Villarreal 3-2 and stay top of La Liga
cards.summary:
Hansi Flick’s side overturned a two-goal deficit to beat Villarreal 3-2 at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday and restore their three-point lead over Real Madrid. Tajon Buchanan scored after five minutes and Tani Oluwaseyi doubled the lead two minutes later.

Gerard Martín headed the first of the comeback on 57 minutes from Pedri’s cross. Fermín López levelled on 61 from Lamine Yamal’s pass, and Pau Navarro’s own goal on 67 completed the turnaround. Barça sit on 36 points from 13 matches.

cards.headline: Flick calls the second-half reaction unbelievable and singles out Pedri
cards.summary:
Hansi Flick told reporters after the match that the reaction was unbelievable after a poor start in which Barça held the ball too long and conceded two goals. He said the side improved the structure at half-time and scored three times in around ten minutes.

The coach described Pedri’s performance as one of his best, praising the way he controlled the midfield and raised the tempo. Marc Bernal and Fermín also received mentions for the way the group stayed together when two down.

cards.headline: Yamal hits the post from the spot then assists Fermín’s equaliser
cards.summary:
Lamine Yamal earned a penalty in the first half after a foul by Tani Oluwaseyi, reviewed by VAR, but struck the post and missed. It was his third miss from seven attempts in La Liga for the club this calendar year.

In the second half he registered his 12th assist of the season, cutting the ball back for Fermín López to finish from the left side of the box. Yamal also started the move that led to the decisive own goal with a backheel to Eric García.

cards.headline: Gerard Martín heads the opener of the comeback from Pedri’s short corner
cards.summary:
Gerard Martín scored the first goal of the recovery on 57 minutes, heading in from Pedri’s cross after a quickly taken short corner. Renato Veiga was caught out as the ball arrived.

The centre-back started alongside Frenkie de Jong and Eric García in a back line that had to absorb an early shock. Martín’s goal sparked the ten-minute spell in which Barça scored three times and turned the match.

cards.headline: Flick unhappy with Hernández Hernández and the fourth official
cards.summary:
Hansi Flick said after the match that he expected difficulties with referee Alejandro Hernández Hernández and that the fourth official focused only on the Barça bench. He received a yellow card himself and Fermín López was sent off from the touchline after being substituted.

The coach added that the linesman and fourth official were very aware of his side and that communication was lacking. He told the players that if that happened they simply had to play better, which they did in the second half.

cards.headline: De Jong starts at centre-back as Cubarsí and Christensen stay out
cards.summary:
Frenkie de Jong started at centre-back alongside Gerard Martín and Eric García. Pau Cubarsí remained on the bench with the minor iliopsoas overload and Andreas Christensen is still missing with the soleus issue that will keep him out for two matches.

Jules Koundé came on for Eric García in the 84th minute after returning to group training. Dani Olmo appeared from the bench on 68 minutes for his first involvement since the adductor injury. Only Rodri, Espart, Bardghji and Christensen remain unavailable.

cards.headline: Fermín levels the score then sees red from the bench
cards.summary:
Fermín López scored the equaliser on 61 minutes, finishing from Lamine Yamal’s pass after Raphinha had recovered the ball high up the pitch. It was his ninth La Liga goal of the season and made up for the early giveaway that led to Buchanan’s opener.

He was substituted on 68 minutes and later shown a red card for protesting to the fourth official while already off the pitch. Pedri said afterwards that the team had suffered from the bad start but the reaction would be remembered.

cards.headline: Squad heads to Baku on Wednesday for the Champions League meeting with Sabah
cards.summary:
Barça travel to Azerbaijan on Wednesday for the Champions League league-phase match against Sabah in Baku. The fixture is the longest trip of the season and sits three days after the Villarreal lunchtime kick-off.

The win keeps the side on 36 points and three clear of Real Madrid, who beat Celta Vigo 2-1 on Saturday. The next league game is the visit to Deportivo on 29 November. Flick has already flagged the need to manage minutes across the congested run.

cards.headline: Official account posts the simple +3 after the final whistle
cards.summary:
FC Barcelona’s English account posted “+3” on Sunday evening after the final whistle. The Spanish account followed with the line “Cuando logras lo que parecía imposible” alongside a match image.

The posts marked the 12th league win of the season and the 24th comeback under Hansi Flick. Villarreal finished with ten men after Pau Navarro’s second yellow in stoppage time.
